contract:
Imports decodeFollowCursor, encodeFollowCursor and followKeysetOrFilter from F1's following.ts, and loadHiddenUsers from @/lib/safety/hidden-users. Unchanged: the rate limit org-invite-search 60/60 (:141-144), requireInviteOfficer (:147-149; owner/admin only, a hidden club is 404 for non-members), blocked_reason (:152-156), and every existing error code.

MODE: mode = (q.length >= Q_MIN && source !== "followers") ? "search" : "followers", where q is read at :158 and source from ?source=. This replaces the early empty return at :159-166. It is safe because nothing calls this route yet. In followers mode q is ignored. cursor = decodeFollowCursor(?cursor); if !ok, 400 invalid_cursor "Invalid cursor". The cursor is ignored in search mode.

FOLLOWERS MODE:
1. hidden = await loadHiddenUsers(supabase, user.id); if !ok, 500 request_failed (C3, fail closed).
2. Service query: from("org_followers").select("id, user_id, first_followed_at").eq("org_id", org.id).neq("source","join").neq("user_id", user.id). The source filter drops rows the join trigger made, which always belong to current members because the leave trigger deletes them. Add .notIn("user_id", hidden.ids) when non-empty, and .or(followKeysetOrFilter("first_followed_at", cursor)) when a cursor was given. Then .order("first_followed_at",{ascending:false}).order("id",{ascending:false}).limit(MAX_RESULTS + FILTER_HEADROOM), which is 30. Never order by created_at (C5, C15). Error: 500 request_failed.
3. Service users.select(CANDIDATE_COLUMNS).in("id", followerIds), with no school_verified filter in SQL. In TS, keep only isDiscoverableAccount(row) && !isTriggerDefaultHandle(row.handle), the same stranger rule as :212. Keep the follow-row order. Error: 500.
4. Run the existing standings Promise.all (:241-261) over the survivors and fail closed exactly as :263-275. DROP anyone with a member role (followed first, joined later) and anyone blocked either way against the officer or the owner. Compute state, eligible, reason, available_at and request_id exactly as :310-375; "member" cannot appear in this mode.
5. Walk the follow rows in order and emit until MAX_RESULTS (20). next_cursor: if output stopped at 20, the cursor of the last follow row read; else if 30 raw rows came back, the cursor of the last raw row; else null. Pages can be short, and the client follows next_cursor.
6. follows_since = that follow row's raw first_followed_at string.

SEARCH MODE: unchanged, except the standings Promise.all gains service from("org_followers").select("user_id, first_followed_at").eq("org_id", org.id).in("user_id", ids); its error joins readErr and fails closed. Each row gains follows_since: string|null. loadHiddenUsers is NOT added here: typing a name must still find a muted person, and blocks are already dropped.

RESPONSE 200 {ok:true, can_invite, blocked_reason, source:"followers"|"search", next_cursor:string|null /*always null in search*/, users:[{id, name, handle, avatar_url, major, year, state, eligible, reason, available_at?, request_id?, follows_since:string|null}]}. Errors: 401 unauthorized, 403 officers_only, 404 not_found, 429, 500 request_failed, and the new 400 invalid_cursor. Update the docblock at :101-132 with the mode rule and the new fields.
acceptance: GET /api/orgs/sae/invite-candidates with no q, as SAE's owner, gives 200 with source "followers", next_cursor null, users containing no members (the owner's own join row is gone), and can_invite/blocked_reason as before.
?q=ab gives source "search"; every row has follows_since (null for non-followers); states match the old response for the same q.
A mod gets 403 officers_only. A non-member on a hidden club gets 404 not_found. Both unchanged.

On a Supabase branch or local stack, with loadHiddenUsers forced to fail, the response is 500 request_failed. A follower who blocked the owner is absent. A follower who followed first and then joined is absent. 45 followers, some sharing one first_followed_at, page through next_cursor with no duplicates and no gaps. Unfollowing and refollowing does not move a student up the list.
`npx tsc --noEmit` is clean and the eslint count is not above HEAD's.
